name: ABB ACS880 real-corpus retrieval evaluation
purpose: Evaluate retrieval and grounded-answer quality on the real ABB corpus without tuning to a single altitude question.

scoring.evidenceRecallTop5: PASS when at least one source in the final top 5 contains the required evidence, not merely a table of contents or related-manual reference.
scoring.answerCorrectness: PASS when the answer states all required facts and calculations without contradicting the source evidence.
scoring.grounding: PASS when the answer does not add unsupported limits, permissions, safety claims, or numeric values.
scoring.navigationNoise: Record how many final top-5 sources are navigation/index/manual-list chunks. This is diagnostic, not an automatic failure when required evidence is still present.
scoring.retrievalChannel: Record semantic, lexical, or both for the selected evidence. Channel is diagnostic, not a pass/fail criterion.

cases.question: Posso installare un ACS880-01 a 3500 metri di altitudine mantenendo la corrente nominale completa? Spiega eventuali limitazioni usando esclusivamente la documentazione disponibile.
expectedGroundTruth: Installation altitude is allowed up to 4000 m when the applicable hardware-manual conditions are met.
Above 1000 m, output current is derated by 1% for every additional 100 m.
At 3500 m the altitude above the 1000 m threshold is 2500 m, so the derating is approximately 25%.
Full nominal output current therefore cannot be maintained under that rule.
cases.failureMode: Compound evidence is split or unique derating evidence is displaced by generic ACS880 chunks.

cases.question: Se uso un ACS880-01 con motore SynRM ma l'opzione +N7502 non è installata, quale impostazione ABB raccomanda di modificare e quali parametri vengono influenzati?
expectedGroundTruth: ABB recommends manually setting bit 1 of parameter 95.21 HW options word 2.
The change affects parameters 25.2, 25.3, 25.15 and 99.3.
cases.failureMode: Exact parameter numbers are missed or replaced by generic SynRM setup guidance.

cases.question: Quale parametro viene usato per attivare le impostazioni di derating per un motore Ex ABB o per un filtro sinusoidale ABB su ACS880-01 SynRM? Cosa dice il manuale se uso un motore Ex non ABB o un filtro sinusoidale diverso da quelli raccomandati?
expectedGroundTruth: Parameter 95.15 Special HW settings is used for the EX motor and ABB sine filter selections.
For non-ABB Ex motors or sine filters other than the recommended ones, the manual says to contact ABB.
cases.failureMode: Conditional wording is lost or the answer generalizes the ABB-specific settings to unsupported hardware.

cases.question: Con 'Low noise optimization' attivo nel parametro 97.09, quali sono le correnti nominale, light-duty e heavy-duty indicate per un ACS880-01-103A-3 a 400 V?
expectedGroundTruth: For ACS880-01-103A-3 at 400 V with Low noise optimization enabled, the table gives 86 A nominal use, 82 A light-duty use and 67 A heavy-duty use.
cases.failureMode: Table rows/columns are mixed, or nearby drive ratings are returned instead of the requested model.

cases.question: Posso alimentare l'encoder di sicurezza FSE-31 da una sorgente esterna invece che dal connettore X31?
expectedGroundTruth: No. The manual warns to use only connector X31 of the FSE-31 module to supply power to the encoder.
Supplying the encoder from a different source can damage the module.
cases.failureMode: The retriever finds generic wiring content and the answer incorrectly permits an external encoder supply.

cases.question: Quanti moduli FSE-31 posso installare su un singolo drive e come devono essere alimentati FSE-31 e FSO-21? Cosa succede se l'alimentazione manca o è insufficiente?
expectedGroundTruth: Do not install more than one FSE-31 module to a drive or inverter unit.
Use the same power supply for FSE-31 and FSO-21.
Without sufficient power FSE-31 remains in Safe state; if FSO is running, FSO goes into fail-safe mode.
cases.failureMode: Only one of the three linked constraints is retrieved.

cases.question: Quale versione minima di Drive Composer Pro è richiesta per mettere in servizio FSE-31 e quali controlli sul numero di encoder e moduli FSE-31 vanno fatti nel commissioning test?
expectedGroundTruth: Drive Composer pro version 1.8 or later is required.
Only one safety encoder must be connected to FSE-31 and it must be on X31.
Only one FSE-31 module must be connected to the drive or inverter unit.
cases.failureMode: Version or commissioning checklist evidence is omitted because the facts are in adjacent sections.

cases.question: Sul modulo FSE-31, cosa significano ENC STATUS spento, STATUS verde lampeggiante e STATUS spento?
expectedGroundTruth: ENC STATUS off means an encoder fault is active.
STATUS flashing green means the module is initializing.
STATUS off means a module fault is active.
cases.failureMode: LED names and states are confused because several rows use the same colors.

cases.question: Che tipo di encoder di sicurezza supporta FSE-31, quale tensione di alimentazione è indicata e qual è la frequenza massima rilevabile dall'ingresso HTL?
expectedGroundTruth: Supported safety encoders are differential push-pull HTL encoders.
The listed supply voltage is 15 V DC.
Only safety-certified encoders are supported.
The HTL encoder input can detect signal frequencies up to 300 kHz.
cases.failureMode: Exact hardware capabilities are diluted by general encoder documentation.

cases.question: Nel collegamento FSE-31, come cambia la tensione VCC tra le revisioni A-E e la revisione F o successive?
expectedGroundTruth: VCC is 24 V DC in revisions A through E.
VCC is 15 V DC in revision F and later.
cases.failureMode: Revision-specific values are merged into one generic voltage.

cases.question: Qual è la lunghezza massima del cavo encoder supportata da FSE-31? Dammi un valore numerico preciso se il manuale lo specifica.
expectedGroundTruth: The manual does not give one universal numeric maximum.
Maximum cable length depends on encoder type, cable type and cable termination.
The encoder manufacturer's data must be consulted for the maximum length.
mustNotClaim: A single universal maximum cable length not explicitly provided by the source
cases.failureMode: Hallucination-resistance test: the model invents a numeric cable length.

cases.question: FSE-31 riesce a rilevare uno slittamento meccanico dell'albero motore rispetto all'encoder?
expectedGroundTruth: No. FSE-31 does not detect mechanical failures outside the encoder, with motor shaft slipping given as an example.
cases.failureMode: Semantic similarity to safety monitoring causes the answer to overstate FSE-31 capabilities.

cases.question: Per un ACS880-01 marine +C132 frame R4-R9 installato a parete servono i vibration dampers +C131? E se lo installo in cabinet?
expectedGroundTruth: For ACS880-01 frames R4 to R9 in wall installations, +C132 requires option +C131 vibration dampers.
Vibration dampers are not needed in cabinet installations.
cases.failureMode: Wall and cabinet requirements are conflated or the frame range is lost.

cases.question: Per la conformità EMC marine in una rete TN messa a terra, quali opzioni/componenti sono richiesti per frame R8 e quali per frame R11?
expectedGroundTruth: Frame R8 requires +E202 and +E208.
Frame R11 requires +E202 (ARFI-10), +E208 and two input-side common-mode ferrite rings.
cases.failureMode: Frame-specific requirements are mixed together or the ferrite-ring count is omitted.

cases.question: Per un ACS880-01 marine IP21 oppure IP55 frame R1-R7/R9, quale derating della corrente nominale si applica a 50 °C rispetto al valore della rating table a 45 °C?
expectedGroundTruth: For the specified ACS880-01 variants, rated output current is derated by 1% per added 1 °C in the documented range.
From 45 °C to 50 °C the reduction is 5%, corresponding to a factor of 0.95 relative to the 45 °C rating-table value.
cases.failureMode: The model confuses the temperature range endpoint with the 45 °C rating-table reference or applies a rule from another frame/variant.
